subject: Oceanography
title: How Oceans Formed
description: A 60-second lesson on How Oceans Formed.

hook.text: Four billion years ago, Earth had no oceans—just a molten rock ball wrapped in steam.

buildup.text: As Earth cooled, volcanic steam condensed into rain that fell for millions of years.

discovery.text: Water also arrived from space—comets and asteroids delivered ice to the young Earth.

twist.text: Geochemists found that volcanic outgassing, not comets, supplied most of our ocean water.

climax.text: By 3.8 billion years ago, liquid oceans covered much of the planet—and life soon followed.

punchline.text: Earth's oceans rained down from its own volcanoes.

quiz.question: Where did most of Earth's ocean water come from?
